Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 11497 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sahib., There is a Imam (Ahlim) in Jumma Masjid in Labour Camp but the Imam is trimming his beard instead of growing his beard, can we made Namaz beside this imam? Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sahib., There is a Imam (Ahlim) in Jumma Masjid in Labour Camp but the Imam is trimming his beard instead of growing his beard, can we made Namaz beside this imam? Answer ID: 11497 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 490/358=L/1430) The salah is makrooh behind an imam who trims his beard; therefore if there is any other mosque nearby where the imam is pious and following the Sunnah, then you should perform salah behind him. Yes, in case of compulsion, you can pray behind the imam mentioned above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
